author: Aletheia I
title: Deep Residual 1D CNN for RNA Sequence Modeling
abstract: Building on the success of a simple 1D CNN, this submission implements a deeper architecture using residual connections (ResNet-style blocks). The model consists of multiple stacked residual blocks, allowing it to learn more complex and hierarchical features from the RNA sequences without suffering from vanishing gradients. Each block contains two convolutional layers and an identity shortcut connection. This is hypothesized to further improve performance over the single-layer CNN baseline, especially on more complex datasets.
